basic_details.job_title: District Agriculture Office Pakur Crop Protector Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 6 Posts

age_limit.details: The minimum age is 18 years, and the cut-off date for age determination is 30 September 2026. | Ex-servicemen will be given an upper age relaxation of five years, subject to submitting the relevant certificate.

qualification.details: Candidates must be local residents of Pakur district.

salary_details.details: The appointment is purely honorarium-based, and employees do not acquire any automatic right to regular appointment, regularisation, or service benefits equivalent to regular government employees.

selection_process: The selection process consists of scrutiny of applications
preparation of a merit list based on academic and training marks
a practical test for bicycle riding and tree climbing skills
how_to_apply: Download the application form and notification from the official website pakur.nic.in or atmapakur.co.in.
Fill out all mandatory details in the application form clearly in Hindi or English.
Attach self-attested photocopies of educational certificates, training certificates, local residential certificate, and identity proof.
Affix a recent passport-size self-attested photograph on the application form.

Submit the completed application form either in person or by registered/speed post to the Office of the District Agriculture Officer, Combined Agriculture Building, Block Campus, Pakur, Pin Code-816107.
Ensure the application reaches the office on or before 16 October 2026 up to 5:00 PM.
important_instructions: Incomplete applications or those received after the last date will be rejected. The appointment is for 11 months on a contract basis and does not grant any automatic claim for regular service. Candidates must be capable of riding a bicycle and climbing trees, which will be verified via a practical test. Local language proficiency is a qualifying criterion. The competent authority reserves the right to modify the number of posts or cancel the recruitment process. Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification. Original documents will be verified before final selection.

content_sections.heading: District Agriculture Office, Pakur Crop Protector Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of scrutiny of applications, preparation of a merit list based on academic and training marks, a practical test for bicycle riding and tree climbing skills, and verification of original documents.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for District Agriculture Office, Pakur Crop Protector
content_sections.text: Download the application form and notification from the official website pakur.nic.in or atmapakur.co.in. Fill out all mandatory details in the application form clearly in Hindi or English. Attach self-attested photocopies of educational certificates, training certificates, local residential certificate, and identity proof. Affix a recent passport-size self-attested photograph on the application form. Submit the completed application form either in person or by registered/speed post to the Office of the District Agriculture Officer, Combined Agriculture Building, Block Campus, Pakur, Pin Code-816107. Ensure the application reaches the office on or before 16 October 2026 up to 5:00 PM.

content_sections.text: Matriculation / 10th pass certificate and marksheet Intermediate / 10+2 certificate and marksheet (if applicable) Graduation certificate and marksheet (if applicable) Minimum 05-day training certificate and additional training certificates (if any) Local language proficiency certificate (if applicable) Valid local residential certificate issued by a competent authority Caste certificate (if applicable) EWS certificate (if applicable) Identity proof (Aadhar card / Voter ID) Character certificate
